description: Recommends open-source projects for a need (e.g. 'MCP server to query Postgres', 'self-hosted Google Photos replacement', 'terminal coding agent'), from Repolode's comparisons of similar projects: the default pick, strong alternatives and specialists, when to choose and avoid each, plus a scenario guide. Projects are judged on code substance, engineering, real usage (downloads) and maintenance, not stars alone. Falls back to keyword search when no comparison covers the need.

language.description: Only projects written in this language, as GitHub names it (e.g. 'Python', 'TypeScript').

limit.description: How many results, at most 15; default 10.

need.description: What the project should do, in plain words.

permissive_license.description: Only permissively licensed projects (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC, MPL-2.0…).

name: choose_project
title: Choose an open-source project for a need
